title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten no-cost, under-21-safe ways for Nazareth students to spend time together through campus recreation and arts spaces.

cards.title: Use the GTC Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center
cards.notes: Bring your NazCard, meet a friend at the fitness center, and use the walk-in space during posted GTC building hours.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost fitness-center meet-up for current Nazareth students.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that current students may access the Golisano Training Center at no cost and that its Fitness Center is open for walk-in use.
cards.access_notes: For current students with a valid NazCard; check posted building hours and space reservations before going.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center
cards.notes: Swipe in with your NazCard, choose a lap pace together, and confirm the track is not reserved before starting.
cards.short_summary: An indoor walking or running hang at GTC.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists an indoor track at the Golisano Training Center and says current students may access the facility at no cost.
cards.access_notes: For current students with a valid NazCard; specific spaces can close when reserved for events.

cards.title: Play on the GTC Courts
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center
cards.notes: Check open recreation availability, bring a small group, and use the indoor courts for a casual game or skills practice.
cards.short_summary: Court time for basketball, tennis, volleyball, and other open activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth says GTC indoor courts are open for basketball, tennis, volleyball, and more, and that current students have no-cost facility access.
cards.access_notes: For current students with a valid NazCard; use is subject to GTC hours and reservations.

cards.title: Take a Group Exercise Class
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center programming
cards.notes: Check the current class schedule, invite a friend, and arrive ready to follow the instructor’s session and facility guidance.
cards.short_summary: Scheduled group movement classes available without a class fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s GTC FAQ states there is no fee for group exercise classes, and Intramurals & Recreation says fitness classes are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: Free for Nazareth students; review the current schedule, location, and any eligibility details before attending.

cards.title: Join an Intramural League
cards.subtitle: Intramurals & Recreation
cards.notes: Look for the current league options, organize a team or join available play, and use the schedule to plan a recurring hang.
cards.short_summary: Student recreation leagues built around shared play.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that all Intramurals & Recreation leagues are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: Free for Nazareth students; league offerings and registration details vary by term.

cards.title: Enter a Recreation Tournament
cards.subtitle: Intramurals & Recreation
cards.notes: Watch recreation updates for the next tournament, bring teammates if needed, and use it as a low-pressure group activity.
cards.short_summary: One-off campus tournaments with no student participation fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that all Intramurals & Recreation tournaments are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: Free for Nazareth students; consult current recreation updates for tournament format, time, and location.

cards.title: Drop Into Open Recreation
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center recreation
cards.notes: Use the open-recreation schedule to find an available session, then meet up for an informal game or active break.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that all Intramurals & Recreation open events are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: Free for Nazareth students; confirm the current open-recreation schedule and whether a space is reserved.

cards.entity_name: Golisano Training Center Equipment Room Bike Loan
cards.title: Borrow a Bike
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center equipment room
cards.notes: Ask the equipment room about bike availability, borrow what you need, and head out together for a ride on an appropriate route.
cards.short_summary: Campus recreation equipment lending that includes bikes.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth says its recreation equipment includes bikes to borrow and that its fitness and recreation offerings are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: For Nazareth students; confirm equipment-room procedures, availability, and return expectations before borrowing.

cards.entity_name: Golisano Training Center Equipment Room Ski Loan
cards.title: Borrow Skis for an Outing
cards.subtitle: Golisano Training Center equipment room
cards.notes: Check with the equipment room about ski availability and conditions, then plan a daylight outing that matches everyone’s experience level.
cards.short_summary: Recreation equipment lending that includes skis.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth says its recreation equipment includes skis to borrow and that its fitness and recreation offerings are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: For Nazareth students; verify equipment-room procedures, availability, and suitable conditions before borrowing.

cards.title: Swim During Open Pool Hours
cards.subtitle: Shults Center
cards.notes: Confirm an open-pool time, bring required swim gear, and plan a relaxed swim or poolside catch-up with a friend.
cards.short_summary: Campus pool time available through Nazareth recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists open pool hours among its recreation offerings and states that all of those sports, fitness, and recreation opportunities are free for Nazareth students.
cards.access_notes: For Nazareth students; confirm current open-pool hours and applicable pool rules before visiting.
